issue.titleEn: FROM THE WORK TO THE WORLD
issue.positionEn: From creative proposals to real use, keep facts, intentions and results still to be observed distinct.
issue.introEn:
A major shōjo manga exhibition opening at the National Art Center, Tokyo is this issue’s starting point. From there we enter workshops, a playing field, laboratories, records and recently closed exhibitions: projects with different origins, aims and responses still to be observed.

This is a non-production Preview. Exhibition retrospectives state their dates; external images retain their official sources and local non-documentary fallbacks.
issue.closingEn: From design and release to everyday use, each project has its own next chapter. On returning to it, the question is whether those promises leave observable changes.

nact-shojo-manga-infinity-2026.summaryEn: From rotating original pages to publishing history, the exhibition places three artists within their working conditions rather than leaving only legendary names.
nact-shojo-manga-infinity-2026.captionEn: Official exhibition promotional image from the National Art Center, Tokyo; not an installation photograph.
nact-shojo-manga-infinity-2026.altZh: 《少女漫画・インフィニティ》展览宣传横幅。

undercover-valentin-workwear.summaryEn: Working conditions, movement and fabric enter the design brief. The campaign uses a real workshop; everyday performance remains to be observed.
undercover-valentin-workwear.captionEn: Official UNDERCOVER collaboration image, photographed by Jonas Loellmann, showing the workshop team in the campaign.
undercover-valentin-workwear.altZh: Studio Valentin Loellmann 马斯特里赫特工坊外的团队合影。

nike-outkast-georgia-2026.summaryEn: A team mark, Outkast’s crown and the year of ATLiens meet in a clothing collection and a game-day project.
nike-outkast-georgia-2026.captionEn: An athlete wears the Outkast U collection in an official Nike image.
nike-outkast-georgia-2026.altZh: Nike 运动员身穿 Outkast U 系列。

noa-clean-noise-album-2026.summaryEn: NOA wrote and composed all ten songs. His interviews offer a first look at how “clean” and “noise” organize the album.

asics-michigan-amsi-lab-2026.summaryEn: After AMSI Lab opens, the question is how research, athlete feedback and product development connect beyond the laboratory name.
asics-michigan-amsi-lab-2026.captionEn: Official ASICS laboratory announcement image; it does not establish the performance of a specific product.
asics-michigan-amsi-lab-2026.altZh: ASICS 与密歇根大学研究实验室的发布图。

apple-designers-of-tomorrow-paris-2026.summaryEn: The Paris exhibition closed on October 25. Four design practices explored how an object can invite us to pause and be present.
apple-designers-of-tomorrow-paris-2026.captionEn: Official Apple photograph of the Paris exhibition, which closed on October 25.
apple-designers-of-tomorrow-paris-2026.altZh: 展厅内陈列着黑色串珠椅、家具与一盏灯。

wales-bonner-adidas-fw26-archive.summaryEn: A collaboration referring to 1980s London considers the archive in the present. Release plans and actual wearer response remain separate.
wales-bonner-adidas-fw26-archive.captionEn: Official adidas media-library image 734969, labeled for online editorial use.
wales-bonner-adidas-fw26-archive.altZh: adidas 与 Wales Bonner 2026 秋冬宣传影像中的一件白色衬衫。

auralee-tekla-wintering-2026.summaryEn: From knitwear and sleepwear to bedding and blankets, the second collaboration places the season between clothing and home.
auralee-tekla-wintering-2026.captionEn: Official AURALEE image for the second collaboration.
auralee-tekla-wintering-2026.altZh: AURALEE 与 Tekla 的 wintering 合作宣传图。

flaming-lips-teardrop-throbs-2026.summaryEn: The album is scheduled for January 2027. The released single and the creators’ track notes provide an entry point for listeners.
flaming-lips-teardrop-throbs-2026.captionEn: Album artwork published by Third Man Records; the complete album is scheduled for January 2027.
flaming-lips-teardrop-throbs-2026.altZh: The Flaming Lips《The Teardrop Throbs》的蓝色专辑封面。

miu-miu-holiday-2026-campaign.summaryEn: A holiday campaign and a recently closed Diop exhibition: pairing the two rooms is this article’s reading, rather than a brand-declared single project.
miu-miu-holiday-2026-campaign.captionEn: Official Miu Miu Holiday 2026 campaign image by Tina Barney, from the brand’s campaign page.
miu-miu-holiday-2026-campaign.altZh: Miu Miu Holiday 2026 官方主图，画面中为本季广告阵容。
